Because again, she still wanted to emphasize that she still believed they were the target that night and Charlie and Calvin weren't. They just happened to come along at the wrong time. (00:42:44)

[Mantle]: That's just an opinion, Jeffrey. It's nothing else. But Maria has also gone on the record and said, I've had contact with them since. And I've had another sighting of the object some years later in another town nearby where she lives. While she was out driving with her granddaughter one evening. And she's asked, she's queried about going under hypnosis again, which we haven't talked about. It might happen in the future. (00:43:20)

[Mantle]: We don't know. (00:43:20)

[Mishlove]: Well, it seems to me that her case is of particular interest because this sense of certainty that she had that they were waiting for her, as if they already knew who she was, as if maybe she'd had some prior experiences, although unconscious. (00:43:40)

[Mantle]: Yeah, I mean, you're spot on there, Jeffrey, because she believed that what her husband, Jerry, told her, although he didn't, you know, emphasise it, was that things had happened before. And he was just trying to protect her. You know, that's why he didn't tell her anything. I mean, they had two daughters and it was their daughter who made that comment on YouTube. Both daughters knew about the UFO sighting, the blue thing, but nothing else. So they haven't even told their daughters, both of whom were adults now, of course. (00:44:16)

[Mantle]: And so she suspects that the things may have happened previously, but Jerry didn't tell her in order to try and protect her. He only told her so much when he was about to die. And it's like a deathbed confession, Jeffrey, although it took several weeks or months before he passed away. (00:44:35)

[Mishlove]: Well, did they provide details regarding what happened during the abduction? (00:44:42)

[Mantle]: A little bit, you know, a little bit, because Maria says when we first spoke to Maria and when Dr. Scott spoke to her, she was very emotional and she kept talking. She said to me, I often wondered, Philip, if something similar didn't happen to us. And I said, why do you say that? I can see these things, but I can't quite make it out. So what Jerry told her is that these two creatures had got a hold of him and one had got a hold of her. That's the one that came up out of the water. (00:45:14)

[Mantle]: And he called them the gray humanoids. She called it the gray man. And Jerry hinted that one of them was in control because he kept saying, I've got my eye on him. They literally pointed like that. I've got my eye on him, you know. And she said she could see the edge of the ship, the UFO, whatever you want to call it, because she was scared stiff and she had her eyes almost closed. But she said out of the corner of my eye, I could see this metal thing that was there. (00:45:50)

[Mantle]: The two creatures had gone out of her husband. And when she was under hypnosis, a lot of what she said was she was just wondering where the hell her husband was. You know, she was very emotional again under hypnosis. He's not here. Where's Jerry? Where's my husband? And when Chelsea interviewed her, she said they can just put you to sleep just like that. You know, it's bumping you out and you don't remember any of it. And she did. (00:46:24)

[Mantle]: She emphasised that several times. So, again, I put the whole transcript of the interview in the new book, Past Google or Uncovered, so people can read it for themselves and make their own judgment. But, you know, Maria's not looked for money or asked for any money or anything like that. Had her daughter not put that comment on YouTube, we probably never have known about it, Jeffrey. You know, we got other witnesses in and around the area, but nothing to that extent. And there's even more witnesses we've interviewed in the surrounding area as well. (00:47:03)

[Mishlove]: Well, Calvin, as you mentioned earlier, reported that there was a female, apparently human or more human than the other creatures who told him, don't be afraid, we're not going to hurt you. Did she report encountering the same female? Not at all. (00:47:27)

[Mantle]: No, the female is unique to Calvin's testimony. And what was even fascinating is Calvin went on to tell us they had another encounter in 1993. This time he went out on a little boat on his own. During the day, he said, I was only going for a couple of hours. He told his wife where he's going, park the car up, off he goes. He said, I had a bottle of water and a sandwich. And he said, I'm fishing away. (00:47:58)

[Mantle]: He looks up, he says, there's a cloud there. And he looks up, he says, not a cloud, because it opened up. And the next thing he knew, it was the early hours of the morning. He's covering this black goo. He's got some fish, he's had his sandwich, can't remember any of this. Goes back to his car. There's even a note under his car, a windscreen wiper from his wife. She'd been out looking for him. (00:48:24)

[Mantle]: Where the hell are you? Because he didn't have a cell phone, you know. So he goes back home and he says, oh, I had engine trouble. You know, he didn't tell her anything. Now, Calvin had a friend who had a little bit of knowledge about the UFO topic. And his friend said, there's a guy called Bud Hopkins who specializes in this kind of thing. He's at a conference in Florida. So they literally jumped in the car, drove, I think he said it's like 13 hours to Florida. The conference was at a hotel. (00:49:05)

[Mantle]: Calvin wouldn't go in. So his friend went in, found Bud Hopkins. Bud says, here's my room key, time I'll meet him there. Which he did. So Calvin tells him the story. Bud knew who he was once, you know, once he met him. And they agreed to undergo hypnosis there and then. And we managed to obtain a copy of the recording that was made, a cassette. And on that recording, you have Calvin detailing what happened in 1993, what happened in 1973, and two of the things that happened when he was a young boy. (00:49:45)

[Mantle]: All four of these encounters featured this female. In 1993, Calvin said, I was up again in this thing on this bed. The ugly thing is there, this woman's there. And she's telling him things. He got up and she said, there was this kind of mirror, although it wasn't a mirror. It was something reflective. And he calls this the curse. He says, she showed me things about mankind, the past, the present and the future. And the future wasn't, wasn't rosy. (00:50:21)

[Mantle]: It was death and destruction and war and famine worldwide. That's why he called it a curse. And he said, all these little pieces of light, lightning thing, little sparking objects flew around this room and he's having to duck out of the way. Calvin said, I've had enough of this. And he got hold of this creature and he's bashing her head against the wall. And he said, if there's a door there, we're both going out of it. But again, the big guy touched him, it was frozen solid, and that was the end of it. (00:50:56)

[Mantle]: But even then the two little things he talks about when a young boy, not in any great detail, it was this female. And he said, I'm sure she had some kind of mask. And I said, describe her. He said, well, all I can say is if you saw her in a bar, you buy her a drink. You know, she's pretty, she was attractive, you know, to this skintight suit on, if you like. But he said, I'm sure there was, what I was seeing was a mask, you know, so she was the common denominator. (00:51:32)

[Mantle]: None of the others saw this lady, but Calvin did. And after Calvin passed away, I was doing a search online and I found a website that had been set up in the 90s by a local journalist. Hadn't been used in a long time. It had a couple of interviews embedded into it, a couple of police officers who'd seen something in the area. And hey, presto, there was a little video of Calvin. You know, in the early 90s, he got, his head had gone a little bit, he put a bit of weight on, but it was certainly Calvin. And he tells about what happened in 1973. And then he stops, turns to the camera and tells about another encounter in 1992 in Baldwin, Louisiana. Now, nobody had ever heard of this at all. (00:52:33)

[Mantle]: He never mentioned it to me. I became good friends with Calvin. His wife didn't know. Nobody had ever heard about it. I found a conference proceedings from about the same time where Calvin writes a piece in it. He's supposedly be going to be a speaker at this conference. And he's telling everyone, I'm going to tell you the big story. I'm going to reveal everything. Of course, he never appeared at the conference. (00:53:00)

[Mantle]: He also told me that about that time as well, um, he was earning a decent salary and him and Charlie wanted to do their own TV show on cable. And they, you know, they filmed bits for it, but it never, it never got off the ground, Jeffrey. So I think that little film was one of those that they filmed for this TV show that never happened. So again, I transcribed all of this. It's all in the new book, Uncovered. You can read about it yourself and, um, make of it what you will. (00:53:37)

[Mishlove]: I did see Calvin speak at a conference in the desert in California. What year was that, Jeffrey? This was about two or three years ago. (00:53:48)

[Mantle]: Yeah. After his book came out, he did a few, um, conferences, a handful. And he liked it because people took him serious. They didn't make fun of him. And he loved talking, you know, Calvin had got that Southern hospitality, like speaking of people and what have you. He was due to come to England, but then he took ill and we didn't realise at the time it was anything serious, but he wasn't able to travel. And I think Calvin knew at that point before it had been confirmed by the doctors that this was not going to be a good outcome. (00:54:27)

[Mantle]: He'd been ill before he'd had open heart surgery and other things. This was different. So he wrote a piece and he said, he sent it to me and this is do not publish this until I die. I said, okay. So I, I put it in a folder and left it there. Of course, when he passed away, and this is Calvin's take on what happened to him and what have you, that his last words, so to speak. And again, they're featured in full in the new book. (00:54:58)

[Mantle]: And it's rather moving, you know, he blamed, he blamed Charlie for letting the story out in the first place. But I don't, I think he was wrong because another gentleman contacted us. It's called Mr. Van Payne. Mr. Payne said, I think I was the first person to interview Charlie and Calvin. I'm a journalist. So he said, I got a tip off from the Sheriff's office about what was happening. He said, by the time I got there, they'd gone. (00:55:35)

[Mantle]: So he said, I went to the Sheriff's office the next morning and they weren't there. They were at the hospital. So he said, I went to the hospital and they'd gone. And I was told they'd gone to Keesler Air Force Base. So he drove to Keesler Air Force Base, waited outside and he actually got Charlie and Calvin as they came out. And they initially said no, but then they agreed to be interviewed on camera so long as their faces weren't to the lens. So they stood with their back to the camera. (00:56:11)

[Mantle]: This gentleman in between them, he's facing the camera and the microphone was going backwards and forwards. And that's the first television interview anyway. But the point is he got a tip off directly from the Sheriff's department. It wasn't from Charlie. So I think Calvin was a bit wrong in that respect. And not only that, Mr. Van Payne still had the film and he provided us with a copy. But what is interesting as well, this was originally 16 millimetre film, Jeffrey, not video. (00:56:44)

[Mantle]: So he couldn't record over it. He then went on to say, well, I interviewed this other guy. And this was a gentleman at the local civil defence force. He was their meteorological officer. I can't remember his name off the top of my head, but he actually got something on radar that night. So Mr. Van Payne goes into his office with all the gear around it and interviews him there. And we have that. (00:57:11)

[Mantle]: And he said, and there's another one. He said there was a local taxi driver claimed to have seen a UFO land and this creature come out. He just forgot that his friend was parked behind him and his friend says he didn't see anything. There was nothing there. It was a hoax. So we have that. So we have all these three interviews on this one piece of film. And we have a, you know, a digital copy of it. (00:57:37)

[Mantle]: So a piece of, again, ufological history, like the stuff we talked about with Harder and Hynek from APRO. And again, I transcribed all that. I've got pictures from it all in the new book. (00:57:49)

[Mishlove]: Well, one of the things that you and I discussed a little earlier is that the description of the creatures with the pointy protrusions from where ears might be and where the nose might be and no neck. And if I recall correctly, no mouth. This is very unusual in all of the hundreds of UFO sightings and non-human intelligence descriptions that we have in the literature. It seems relatively unique. (00:58:26)

[Mantle]: It is absolutely unique. And I first read about the case back in the 1980s in a magazine. And the thing that stuck in my mind was these creatures, the shape of it. And of course, we didn't have this technology in those days. Searching for things is much, much easier today. And one of the things we have done is try to see if we can find a case that has any similar creatures. And we can't. (00:58:53)

[Mantle]: We're never saying that there isn't any. What we say is, to the best of our knowledge, there isn't. And if anyone knows differently, please get in touch. We'd love to know. But not even in the science fiction literature at the time. I mean, on TV in America was probably The Outer Limits. Here we had Doctor Who. And none of the creatures looked anything like... they were all men in suits, pretty much most of the monsters, you know. So there was nothing that we could say, well, this is similar or that's similar. (00:59:29)

[Mantle]: But of course, a couple of years later, you have Travis Walton's encounter in Snowflake, Arizona. And some of the creatures he saw were pretty much looking like human male and females, you know. But they had a headgear on, transparent headgear. That was the only difference. So, you know, for me, this case, with all the information, I mean, we've interviewed over 50 witnesses, Jeffrey, or I should say Dr. Scott has, and historical recordings, because both Charlie and Calvin described these creatures as robotic. That wasn't something that came out years later. (01:00:17)

[Mantle]: It was right from the very beginning, because we have those audio tapes with Harder and Hynek, and they mentioned these guys said that they were robotic. So it was right from day one. And the reason for that is because they never made a noise. They couldn't hear them breathing, you know, no eyes, no mouth. They moved in a mechanical manner as far as they were concerned. It is only their opinions, nothing more. But in the 1992 encounter in Louisiana, it still puzzles me why Calvin never mentioned it. (01:00:56)

[Mantle]: He has them as like workers and the woman is in charge. He meets them again. And the reason they are here is to try and help mankind because their race of beings, wherever they come from, have already gone through planetary catastrophe. They've made all the mistakes so they can help us not make them, so to speak. And that's what Calvin's opinion was, you know, in his final words, which is not too dissimilar to what Charlie believed. Charlie never had another encounter. (01:01:30)

[Mantle]: He became like a contactee. You know, he got messages from the creatures and he believed something big was going to happen worldwide and he'd be a part of it. He did have another sighting, but no more encounters of that respect. So, you know, they weren't too different in that respect. But those were Calvin's final words. And this creature said they were going to try and help mankind. (01:01:55)

[Mishlove]: Now, what about the woman? Do you know of other sightings that involve a human-like female? (01:02:03)

[Mantle]: Like I said, there's Travis Walton. That's a couple of years later. There was male and female. There's a very famous incident here in the UK, but that was a male. It was a police officer called Alan Godfrey and it's late 1980. He's on patrol in his police car. He's been on night patrol. It's the early hours of the morning. He's about to finish. He lived in a small town called Todmorden. It means nothing to anybody in America, but I know where it is. (01:02:36)

[Mantle]: And there have been reports of some cows wandering around the streets at night and he'd been looking for them. He'd seen an officer on foot patrol, had a chat with him. So I'm going to have one last look for these cows and that's me finished. So he drives up through the little road through the town, puts his indicator on to turn off to go back to the police station when he sees some lights up ahead. So he carries on. (01:03:02)

[Mantle]: He doesn't turn off. And he said, when I get there, Philip, there's this object blocking the road. It's like an old fashioned children's top. It's dark coloured. It's got a bank of panels across the top and the bottom part is spinning. So he stops the patrol car, tries to radio back to the station. He can't get through. So he takes his clipboard out and starts to draw it. Bear in mind the patrol car is stationary at this point. (01:03:33)

[Mantle]: This is the next thing I remember. I'm several hundred yards down the road, driving the patrol car, no recollection of starting it up again. He turned around and this thing had gone. He noticed on the road it was dry and it had been raining through the night. There was a dry patch on the road. When he got back to the station, he was late. And he had a burn mark on the instep of his left foot and his police boot was split. So he reported it. (01:04:03)

[Mantle]: His name is Alan Godfrey, police constable. The next day they asked him to write a formal report, which he did. Cutting a long story short, six or seven months later, he was teamed up with some UFO investigators. They hired two psychiatrists to put Alan under hypnosis. And under that hypnosis, he sees two types of creatures. One he kind of repels from. So they've got a head like the old fashioned light bulbs. And then there's a man. (01:04:40)

[Mantle]: A man in a white robe. He's got a little skull cap on. He's got a little white beard. And he's even called it, he calls him Joseph. And there's even a black dog. So there's no woman, but there is a man. You know, it looks just like a man in a white robe. And Alan to this very day, you know, he said, Philip, if I had a brick, I could have thrown it at that thing and it would have gone clunk. You know, and I've seen the hypnosis tape, you know, and it is fascinating. (01:05:15)

[Mantle]: So there are other accounts where human-like beings have been reported, but I don't recollect any from before. Calvin, there may be. (01:05:27)

[Mishlove]: It turns out I've done some interviews recently that do involve a lady, one very well-known case in the United States with a fellow named Chris Bledsoe who talks about regular contacts with a female being who appears in orbs. And there's another case, it's written about in a book called The Mojave Incident, in which a couple were driving down the highway in the desert in Nevada and were abducted in a very frightening case. And again, there was a woman aboard who said, don't worry, we're not going to hurt you. (01:06:07)

[Mishlove]: But they were scared out of their minds. (01:06:10)

[Mantle]: Yeah, it's not uncommon, but going back to 1973, I don't think you could have laid your hands on it anywhere. You wouldn't have seen it on TV, perhaps, or in the science fiction literature. And of course, Calvin was not interested in any of these. Anyway, he was working three jobs just to try and get married. That's one of the reasons why Calvin didn't want the story to get out. He thought, they'll never let me get married. (01:06:34)

[Mantle]: You know, they'll think we're nuts. And there was a big discussion at the time. The Archdebunker, of course, in those days were Philip Class. And Philip tried to get involved in the case. And both guys, right from day one, said, we'll have a polygraph. No problem. Now the polygraph was arranged, but when it was arranged, Calvin was taken ill. He'd gone back home. He was in hospital. But Charlie said, I'm here. (01:07:03)

[Mantle]: So he had the polygraph and he passed it. And it was released into the news media. Philip Class found it odd that the polygraph guy wasn't a local man. He came from New Orleans, which was, I don't know, 60, 70 miles away. What we found was, oh sorry, Class also claimed that this gentleman wasn't qualified. Well, what I found was that the two local companies that did polygraphs were asked if they'd do it. One says, I am not getting involved with any of this UFO nonsense. (01:07:50)

[Mantle]: No, thank you. The other one said, I'd happy to do it, but we only give polygraphs to people who've been accused of a crime. These gentlemen haven't been accused of anything. Now, when the incident happened, when it, you know, when it happened, they were working in the shipyard. The shipyard owner said, you can use, if you need him, you can use my attorney. It's there if you need him. Just so happened this attorney knew a company in New Orleans that did polygraphs amongst other things. (01:08:22)

[Mantle]: They were called the Pendleton Detective Agency. And he phoned them up and they'd even do it for free. So they sent a gentleman called Scott Glasgow, who was qualified. He just hadn't received the paperwork, but he was more than qualified. Not only that, Scott Glasgow was extremely sceptical and he ran the test three times and every time Charlie passed it and it irritated him to release that, but he had no choice. Now, I also found that the Pendleton Detective Agency was still in business. (01:08:55)

[Mantle]: So I wrote to them, not email, the old fashioned way, and they responded and they confirmed that this, that, the other, you know, so Philip Klass never even bothered contacting them. And I found Philip Klass's file. He has a big file on this case and all he's trying to do, Jeffrey, is throw mud at it. He's not trying to research it. I know you know as well as I do, if you throw enough mud, some of it sometimes sticks and he couldn't find anything wrong with it. You know, as simple as that. (01:09:28)

[Mantle]: I'll give you one little story that Calvin told me. It's the one and only time he met Philip Klass. Charlie was doing a TV show and he asked Calvin if they could meet, not for him to go on it, just meet up. So Calvin said, okay. And Charlie told him there's a scientist going on this show with him and it had been arranged by a local journalist. So when Calvin gets there, the TV show has been cancelled and he's no idea what's going on. (01:10:01)

[Mantle]: And so he asked Charlie, so what's the matter? He said, well, this scientist won't go on with me. So the journalist trying to calm things down, takes all three of them over the road for some dinner. He thinks if I can buy him a dinner, we can still go back and do this. You know, Calvin's oblivious. And so he says to this guy, why won't you go on TV with Charlie? He says, because he's lying. (01:10:32)

[Mantle]: So Calvin was a tough guy. He didn't mind a fight. Now Calvin didn't mind if you didn't believe him, Jeffrey, but if you accuse him of lying, you were in trouble. So Calvin told Philip class in no uncertain terms, I won't say the exact words, but if you call me or my friend a liar again, I'll punch your lights out basically. And Calvin said, we went home that night with no dinner, you know, but he said, I don't mind if he said, I can understand why people don't believe me, Philip, but calling me a liar is a different thing than saying, I don't believe you, you know. And so that was the one and only time he met Philip class. (01:11:20)

[Mantle]: And so again, I found that Philip had interviewed Scott Glasgow and I have a transcript of it in from his own files. All that again is in the new book. It tells you it ties the loose ends up, so to speak. (01:11:35)

[Mishlove]: Well, Philip Mantle, this has been a fascinating excursion into one of the most important cases in UFO history. You've done a very commendable job over many years, tracking down so many witnesses, so many documents, so many recordings. I can only commend you for the work that you have done and thank you so much for spending time with me. Oh, thank you. My pleasure. Thank you. And for those of you watching or listening, thank you for being with us because you are the reason that we are here. (01:12:14)

[SPEAKER_02]: Book four in the new Thinking Allowed Dialogue series is Charles T. Tartt, 70 Years of Exploring Consciousness and Parapsychology. Now available on Amazon. (01:12:51)

[Mishlove]: New Thinking Allowed is presented by the California Institute for Human Science, a fully accredited university offering distant learning graduate degrees that focus on mind, body, and spirit. The topics that we cover here, we are particularly excited to announce new degrees emphasizing parapsychology and the paranormal. Visit their website at cihs.edu. You can now download all eight copies of the New Thinking Allowed magazine for free or order beautiful printed copies. Go to newthinkingallowed.org. (01:13:33)

(2025-08-30)

entry.title: Craig Hamilton-Parker の 2025-09 の予言
entry.content:
前置き​

整理対象を 1:50--24:49 の範囲に絞った。

概要​

AI

2025年9月の世界予言と課題

この音源は、‌‌Craig Hamilton-Parker氏‌‌による‌‌2025年9月以降の予言‌‌に焦点を当てています。

彼は、‌‌占星術やナーディリーディング‌‌などの複数の情報源を用いて、‌‌差し迫った世界の課題‌‌について語ります。主なテーマは、‌‌英国と米国における移民問題による社会不安、経済的な困難、ウクライナ情勢の悪化、そしてヨーロッパにおける予期せぬ紛争‌‌などです。

また、彼はこれらの予言が、‌‌歴史的な出来事がゆっくりと発展する傾向‌‌に沿っていることを強調し、‌‌世界平和に向けた火の儀式（ヤジュニャまたはホーマ）の重要性‌‌にも触れています。

目次​

  1. 前置き
  2. 概要
  3. 詳細
    1. 1. 予測の性質と時間的経過
    2. 2. 占星術的背景とエネルギーの蓄積
    3. 3. 移民問題と社会的混乱（特に英国と米国）
    4. 4. 地政学的緊張と紛争
    5. 5. 経済問題
    6. 6. 地球の変動と宇宙イベント
    7. まとめ
  4. ヨーロッパにおける地震（イタリア、ポルトガル）
  5. 時系列
  6. 主要関係者
  7. 情報源
  8. 文字起こし

詳細​

AI

詳細ブリーフィング資料：2025年9月以降の世界情勢予測

概要

本ブリーフィング資料は、Craig Hamilton-Parker氏による2025年9月以降の世界情勢予測に関するポッドキャスト「2025年9月の世界予言と課題」（"World Psychic Predictions September 2025 Craig Hamilton-Parker"）の文字起こしに基づいています。ハミルトン＝パーカー氏は、自身の予言に加えて、ナディ占星術や占星術の要素、そして彼の祖母の意見、さらには「ナチスの予言」（原典では「ナチスの予言」とされているが、文脈上「ナディの予言」の誤訳である可能性が高い）にも言及しながら、来るべき数ヶ月の世界的な課題と転換点について詳細に語っています。

主要テーマと重要なアイデア/事実

1. 予測の性質と時間的経過​

ハミルトン＝パーカー氏は、予測は「一瞬で起こるものではなく、ゆっくりと、煮詰まり、構築されていくもの」であると強調しています（00:03:41）。第一次世界大戦のような歴史的出来事を例に挙げ、多くの原因が絡み合い、徐々に発展していく様子を説明しています。 過去の自身の予測（例：ヨーロッパにおける社会不安の増大）が、時間をかけて実現してきたと述べています（00:04:45）。

2. 占星術的背景とエネルギーの蓄積​

  • 土星の逆行と魚座への移行（Saturn retrograde into Pisces）: 9月に入り、土星が魚座で逆行することで、「過去の未解決の問題に対処する」時期が到来し、長らく燻っていた大きな問題が表面化すると予測されています（00:06:29）。

We've also got what's called a Virgo portal, which means that we've got two new moons in Virgo at the same time. This is an unusual cosmic sort of event. It's unusual to get two moons like that. But this is kind of another transformative type of energy that comes with this at the moment. So, this coming month and also we got in Mercury-Ketu conjunction in Leo too. These are also things that bring some triggers for financial things as well. But basically, overall, we're getting quite an energetic build-up. (00:07:36)

So, for many respects, September is a bit of a turning point for the world at the moment, particularly with old issues. One of the worst that we're dealing with at the moment, I think, is this problem with over migration here in the UK. Now, a lot of you in the USA don't see what goes on in the UK. We don't see what goes on in America often because everything we watch on the news is extremely filtered. It almost gets to the point where I think, why am I watching mainstream news at all? (00:08:07)

Because it's been so filtered out that we don't see anything about what's really going on. They skip over things that are very important. I've mentioned about migration in one of the migrant hotels and things that have been going on. And it's been a kind of a bit of a concern that why aren't these things being spoken about? Why, for example, have we seen absolutely zero on UK news about the deportations going on in Washington? It's too close to what's going on here in London coming up. (00:08:49)

So I feel that we have a real simmering pot of boiling anger underneath the underworld of the world, you know, that's not being talked about. And people are getting very, very upset now. So I see ahead some really difficult times in the UK and in America, because problems that are not being addressed are having to be brought to the public for, particularly here in the UK, because we've got Keir Starmer, our prime minister here, trying to overthrow now, overturn rather, the court rulings about the migrant hotels and so forth, and pulling on board all these left-wing judges to try to reverse what really is the will of the people. Because the will of the people is really, really coming to the fore. (00:09:48)

One of the things we're seeing, of course, is things that are not the will of the people. I was having a look at some of the very left-wing websites recently to see what they say about the migrant hotels, because I like to get a different viewpoint on things. And you can go to them and you can print out your own banners. And it's very obvious that they're extreme left-wings, you know, they were the sort of things that people would never have paid much attention to in the past. (00:10:17)

And they're trying to grab hold of the public abate. Downloadable, printable banners that you can put up, you know, dead easy. You know, when ordinary local people are making protests about the way they see their country as becoming not what it was, it's nothing like what they've known. And this is the number one problem here in the UK, of over-migration, that is causing this tremendous disruptions to the social cohesion of the UK in particular, and people are fed up with it. (00:10:51)

But the government are just trying to put a lid on it all. And you start doing that, and it doesn't usually come out with very good results. Similar things are happening in Europe at the moment. The same idea, there's a pressure point coming, there's a pressure point coming. And I see that in the coming months from September now, right the way through until December, we're going to see some real serious social unrest, particularly in London. And coming up soon, we also have the many protests planned. There's one with, what date is it? (00:11:31)

13th of September, Tommy Robinson's having a march through London. And at the same time, the socialists are calling everybody out to make a counter-protest, trying to get a bigger counter-protest. So now we've got two sides all ready to boil. And I think this will ultimately spill over into violence. And even though they're saying, no, guys, we don't want violence, that's when the left-wing win. The left-wing want you to have violence. The left-wing want street protests. (00:12:05)

They want left-wing, want us to be able to sort of clamp down on it so nobody can protest. All we want is Palestinian flags flying across London, or rainbow flags flying across London, but certainly not the Union Jack and so on, and the English flag. So this is dangerous, I think, when you start to try to repress things, you repress it on the news. And even people like Rhys Mogg, who's a kind of an odd sort of figure, but even he's going at it, if you follow his channel, and go into migrant hotels that have been hidden away in the middle of Somerset and obscure little areas, it's like they're forcing everybody on us. (00:12:50)

And I think this is something that is going to be the issue that needs to be addressed in the coming months. And I feel that it's not being addressed. And I think, and my sense is that they will try to, they will actually overturn the rules about the migrant hotels. And so yes, you know, we can keep people in migrant hotels, because the government's put in a real difficult position now. So they'll overturn that, and that'll cause more public unrest, that'll cause more disruption, it'll cause more... (00:13:17)

Britain's really ready to pop, I feel. What do you think? Do you think I'm right? Am I wrong with this? Because nothing's on the news, but I feel there's a real undercurrent of disruption now. I mean, if you look at it from the government's point of view, what are they going to do with this? What are they going to... they said, we will get rid of everybody by the end of the parliament, and we'll get everybody out of these hotels by the end of the parliament. (00:13:40)

And what they mean by that, we will give every single one of them British citizenship. We won't care about whether they should be here or not, we'll just give them all British citizenship, because we want the problem to go away. And of course, that's not going to work, is it? That's not going to work, because that's only doing the complete opposite to what we really want them to do, you know. So this is a real serious issue that we have here that's got to be addressed. Where do you put them all? (00:14:05)

You know, the only option you've got is to do something very similar to what Farage is suggesting and what's happening in America, which is they're going to have to start actually turfing people out. So on the one hand, you've got people saying, we've got to give them all citizenship, basically. On the other hand, we're saying, no, our country's already overwhelmed. If you give them all citizenship, what happens to the rest? How many more are brought in? (00:14:29)

Every person represented has a whole family behind them as well. So this is a serious issue that I feel is going to be more and more coming to the fore. You know, what do we do? Do we have to have internment camps of some sort to do this? And they say, oh, we can't do that. You know, it's too similar to what happened in Germany in the war. But we can't do that because we practically can't do that. But you could during COVID. We built whole hospitals overnight sort of thing. (00:14:57)

We were building them so rapidly. And it shows, if you've got the right attitude, what can happen. So I feel this is the downfall of the Labour government, ultimately. Margaret Thatcher fell because of the poll tax. And I feel that Starmer will fall because of this. I've been saying he's going to go. And I feel that, will they be in Parliament for another four years? Will we have a Labour government for four years? I think it's very, very unlikely. (00:15:27)

And I feel that this year they will tumble. They will fall. Not just Starmer and everybody else, but the whole lot will go. I see my lights are going all over the place. I seem to have some agreement here with the spirit world in the background. There are red lights flashing. Look at that. Goodness gracious. Anyway, I can see it on the screen here on the side here. So yeah. And who's rubbing their hands at all this, of course? Who's rubbing their hands at all this? (00:15:55)

We've got the Russia and we've got China and Korea all getting together to join a military parade soon. You see, like I say, these predictions, they take time to come about. They take time. They simmer in the background. I was talking about this right back in 2020 about a coalition between China and Russia. And this would be something that we would worry about in the future of the world. And it certainly seems to have happened, doesn't it? You know, I said this and I said this and I said this that it would happen. And it's happening. (00:16:22)

And who wants all these immigration problems? Nothing like having an enemy within, is it? Russia even pushes the people over the border and says, go on, go across the border. Go on. You're not coming here, you know? And the problem is, is we now have serious problems within our own societies. And this, I do feel, is part of this big energetic shift that's happening. That 13th of September march through London, I think, is going to become seriously problems. And I feel as if there will be other ones. (00:16:55)

I feel as if there will be much more aggressive marches into places like Tower Hamlets and places which have become almost where British people are in a minority. And I feel these things are going to boil over, sadly, sadly. So that's one of the things I feel. I think this coming period also is going to be very serious issues with things such as financial problems in the world. I see a number of financial problems ahead. Starting in September, there's going to be... the Nazis actually said about this as well, actually. (00:17:31)

They said that the Nazis said that there will be a downturn in the markets in September. And that's something that I'm feeling at the same time. And Britain is actually close to full economic failure. This is what, again, is going to put the pressure to see the end of this Labour government. It's not quite time, but I feel, I think ultimately we might even get the IMF, International Monetary Fund, having to bail us out or be talking about bailing us out. (00:18:00)

It's going to get that close. There's going to be very shortly, whether it's September or possibly into October with this, there's going to be a crisis budget. There's going to be a crisis budget of some sort, a full budget pulled in unexpectedly, a major budget that's been pulled in that creates great unrest because it will also be tax rises for the poor and the unemployed being hit by this. (00:18:33)

And when the unemployed get hit, that's when you really start to get the problems because it's usually the middle class people don't usually go out and protest a great deal. Middle class people, as it were, that sounds a bit classist, but in many ways it is that. They haven't got time to go out and protest. They haven't got time to go out and make a lot of fuss at their weekends, their precious weekends, and they're much more complacent. (00:18:55)

But often people that are hit the hardest, the ones that haven't got a lot of money, when you take that away from them and they also, they got the time, that's when you start to get really serious protests. That's what brought down Thatcher, the poll tax. And I feel once the poor get hit, then we're really into trouble with this. So you'll have a look in a minute when I put Nanny Joan up. She's got the way to sort out the unemployed, which I think is quite amusing. (00:19:25)

So what else have I got on my list here? Oh yeah, Taylor Swift. I said about the prediction, I said she would marry Travis. And so that's happened. That was a prediction I made a little while back that has happened. The Ukraine issue is going to be important as well in the ways ahead. And what do I see about that? Well, when it came up today, saying, oh, they're going to do this, they're going to do that. I said, no way, there's no deal coming. (00:19:54)

And now today, on the 28th of August when I'm making this, we see another major hit on Kiev. So there's a no deal, definitely a no deal, because the West is now being seen as really weak, because it looks like whatever anybody says, Russia keeps hitting hard at Kiev, wanting to hit those drone factories, I expect. And you can't do deals with dictators, can you? You can't do... and this is where Trump is beginning to be shown to look weak, because he's being pulled along by the nose and being told we can do this deal, we can do a deal, this deal, that deal, you know, we'll give you 10% of Ukraine if we can have 90% of Ukraine, sort of deal, which is completely unacceptable to Ukrainians. And while those things are going on, we keep hitting them hard. So the deal is off. (00:20:47)

And I don't see anything happening in Ukraine as a powerful peace process. I mean, the Nazis actually, some of the Nazi prophecies about this time say that there will be a reconciliation, but I don't see it happening. I think Trump's going to be put in the position where he has to start saying, right, we're going to have to use the stick now. And we'll start giving some arms to Ukraine, because we can't stop this if we're going to have to change the situation somehow. (00:21:19)

Funny enough, when I was tuning in today, I was tuning in, and I was trying to pick up on what I saw ahead. And I saw the whole of Europe asleep. I thought, what? Have they got a sleeping drug or something like that? So I don't know whether there's something in that unusual, something where people are falling asleep. I think it was symbolic, because symbolically, Europe has fallen asleep. Like I say, the crises in the world don't happen overnight. They happen over a period of time. (00:21:47)

And I feel that Europe has been asleep far too long. So will Europe wake up? Will Europe wake up and do something about Ukraine? I think they've got to now. And I think they've got to start putting armaments in. And that's what the moves we're going to see in this coming month with that. The Nazis also, interestingly, I saw, spoke about an unexpected war in a Muslim country. So there's something new that we don't know about, an unexpected war in a Muslim country. (00:22:21)

And it suggested also that a leader could be removed through an assassination. And this is talking about specifically a Muslim country. So let's wait and see what's ahead with that. Will somebody, a leading figure in a Muslim country, be assassinated? So that's an unusual and strange question. So we've got difficulties ahead with the economy coming up shortly. We've got a complete unresolved situation in Ukraine and the situation I see as running further out of control. I feel that Ukraine will try to strike back. Armaments are being given there. (00:23:02)

We've got problems on the streets with the problems with migration. Again, I feel it's flashpoints in France and places. Again, what they see in Britain will be reflected in Europe. And strangely enough, the Nazis also said that there'll be some earth movements in this time too. And it's earth movements in Europe it spoke about. Now, this is not me making a prediction this time. This is from the Nazi predictions. I said that there would be some earthquakes in Italy and Portugal. So let's see if that happens. (00:23:41)

It said in this coming period in August or September. So we're very close now. And it still has concerns about Japan. This is something that I was also concerned about, about the Pacific ring that I spoke about. So there's still thoughts about that. And interestingly, there was another prediction in there saying that in 2026, there would be an event where a small planet or moon, it said, would be hit by an asteroid. So that means something would have to move from the asteroid belt for that to happen. (00:24:09)

And it suggested that this would cause, but it would not be something directly from the asteroid belt, but it would hit something else. And debris from that impact would hit the earth to cause some tsunamis and earthquakes. That's predicted in 2026. That's a Nazi prediction. So not one of mine, but quite interesting nonetheless, because I like to sort of flag things on this show of anything that else has come up where there's been interesting things. So these are some of my kind of simmering predictions for the way ahead. (00:24:45)

(2025-08-29)

entry.title: Gary Baker の証言 : 「レーダーが停止状態だった」という英国防省の主張は嘘だ
entry.summary: レンドルシャムUFO事件：国防省の嘘とレーダー記録
entry.content:
AI

レンドルシャムUFO事件：国防省の嘘とレーダー記録

この動画の文字起こしは、‌‌1980年のレンドルシャムの森UFO事件‌‌を巡る国防省の公式発表に異議を唱えるものです。

当時RAFニーティスヘッドに勤務していたゲイリー・ベイカーは、国防省が主張する「レーダーがオフになっていた」という見解を否定し、‌‌レーダーは24時間体制で稼働しており、当時の状況を記録したレーダー映像が存在するはずだ‌‌と証言しています。彼は、この事件が冷戦下において‌‌国防上の重要性が非常に高い‌‌ものであったにもかかわらず、国防省が事実を隠蔽していると強く示唆しています。

また、‌‌UFO騒動と国防省によるレーダーテープの回収‌‌に関する噂が、当時のニーティスヘッド基地内で広く語られていたことを、元同僚の証言も交えて明らかにしています。ベイカーは、国防省が「不正確な情報」を公開したことに対応して、自身の経験を共有する義務があると感じています。

目次​

  1. 詳細
    1. 主なテーマ
    2. 最も重要なアイデアと事実
    3. 結論
  2. 証言者：元RAF航空兵ゲイリー・ベイカー
  3. RAFニーティスヘッドの役割と機能
  4. 「レーダーテープが持ち去られた」という噂
  5. 時系列
  6. 主要関係者
  7. 情報源

詳細​

AI

レンドルシャムのUFO事件：国防省の嘘に関する詳細ブリーフィング資料

このブリーフィング資料は、ゲイリー・ベイカー元RAF航空機整備士の証言を中心とした「レンドルシャムのUFO：国防省の嘘」と題された情報源に基づいています。1980年12月のレンドルシャムのUFO事件に関する国防省（MOD）の公式見解に異議を唱える重要な情報を提供しています。

主なテーマ​

  • 国防省の公式見解への異議申し立て: 国防省がUFO事件発生時、近隣のRAFレーダー基地で「何事もなかった」と主張し、特にRAFニーティスヘッドのレーダーが「オフになっていた」という公式見解に対し、元RAF航空機整備士のゲイリー・ベイカーがこれを真っ向から否定しています。

  • レーダー運用の重要性と継続性: 冷戦時代における英国南部の防空体制維持において、レーダー監視が極めて重要であったこと、そしてRAFニーティスヘッドでは複数のレーダーシステムが24時間体制で稼働しており、決して「オフになる」ことはなかったという証言。

  • レーダー記録の存在と消失の可能性: すべてのレーダー映像は記録されており、事件や問題発生時には追跡・分析のために不可欠であったという事実。それにもかかわらず、レンドルシャム事件に関連するレーダーテープの「消失」や「利用不能」という報告は、極めて疑わしいとされています。

  • 国防省の情報隠蔽疑惑: ベイカーは、国防省が「おそらく、そしてほぼ確実に、真実を控えめに語っているか、最悪の場合、嘘をついて情報を隠蔽している」と断言しています。

  • 国防上の重要性: 未確認飛行物体が核兵器を搭載した空軍基地の近くに着陸するような事態は、「国防上の考慮事項ではないというのは全くばかげている」と強く主張し、事態の深刻さを強調しています。

最も重要なアイデアと事実​

  • レンドルシャム事件の概要: 1980年12月、サフォークのレンドルシャムの森周辺でUFOが複数夜にわたって目撃された。RAFウッドブリッジとベントウォーターズの米軍関係者も目撃者であった。

  • 国防省の公式発表: 事件から約20年後に公開された公文書では、国防省関係者は、近隣のRAFレーダー基地で「何も異常なものは見られなかった」と主張。特にRAFニーティスヘッドのレーダーは「事件中に電源が切られていた」とされた。

    • SPEAKER_01: "In official documents released some 20 years after the event, Ministry of Defence officials who dealt with the Rendlesham Forest incident at the time, insisted that nothing untoward was seen on neighbouring RAF radar stations. Indeed, the radar equipment at one of those stations, RAF Neathishead, was claimed to have been switched off during the incident."

  • RAFニーティスヘッドの役割と運営:主要任務: 英国南部の領空の完全性を維持するレーダー基地であり、他の機能はなかった。「防空航空機を制御し、敵対的な航空機を迎撃したり、未知の航空機を識別したりする役割」を担っていた。

    • Gary Baker: "And the whole of the operation at Neathishead was geared towards maintaining the integrity of the southern part of the United Kingdom airspace."
    • Gary Baker: "Control of air defence aircraft, in their role as interceptors, in intercepting would be hostile aircraft, or identifying unknown aircraft..."

  • 24時間体制: 2つの飛行隊、それぞれが2つの当直に分かれ、24時間体制でレーダー画像を監視していた。

    • Gary Baker: "each squadron was split into two watches, and the watches were something which was used to maintain 24-hour personnel to be available to cover the radar picture."

  • レーダーの種類と重要性: 主要防空一次レーダーである「Type 84」と「Type 85」、および高高度探知レーダー「HF200」の2つのレーダーが「昼夜を問わず協力して稼働していた」。レーダーの故障や定期メンテナンスがあっても、常に一方のレーダーは稼働状態を維持していた。

    • Gary Baker: "So the radar that RAF Nita said was in fact two radars, both of which were main air defence primary radars, and they were working night and day together..."
    • Gary Baker: "The planned maintenance would be planned so that one radar was operational while the other was, for a brief period of time, maintained to its full operating capacity..."

  • 記録の義務: すべてのレーダー画像は「記録され」「撮影され」ていた。これは事件発生時の分析だけでなく、訓練のためにも不可欠であった。

    • Gary Baker: "But all these radars form the defence network, and all the aircraft which these radars pick up are recorded. All the radars are filmed..."

  • 国防省のレーダー情報に関する疑惑:ゲイリー・ベイカーは、国防省がレンドルシャム事件に関する情報を公開した際に、RAFニーティスヘッドのレーダーカメラが「オフになっていた」と述べ、またRAFワットンのレーダーテープが「非常に粗悪で判読不能な結果で処理されていた」という記事を読み、これを「全く受け入れられない」と感じた。

    • Gary Baker: "But it wasn't until the end of August, when reading UFO magazine, and the article written by Georgina Bruni, stating that the MOD had released information regarding the Rendlesham Forest UFO incident, mentioning RAF Neetershead and RAF Watton, and the radar station, and the fact that the radar camera was switched off at RAF Neetershead, and coincidentally the radar tapes from RAF Easton at Watton had been processed with a very poor, ineligible result, I find absolutely unacceptable."

  • 「冷戦が背景にあったこの時期に、わが国とNATOの防空は非常に重要だった」ことを考えると、このような状況は信じがたい。

  • レーダーテープが「持ち去られた」という噂が、当時基地内で広まっていたとベイカーは証言。

    • Gary Baker: "The UFO flap, and the MOD, had come down to take away the radar tapes."
    • Gary Baker: "It would be, hello Swill, have you heard there's been a big UFO flap on, and the MOD's been down and taken away the radar pictures..."

  • 21年前の出来事ではあるが、同僚も同様の噂を記憶しており、その正確性はベイカー自身と同じ程度であると述べている。

    • Gary Baker: "he remembers exactly the same rumours."
    • 「防衛上の考慮事項ではない」という国防省の主張への反論:ベイカーは、機密保護法を遵守する立場から、国防省が「誤った情報」を公開したと判断したため、内部の人間としての見解を示す義務があると感じている。

  • 空軍基地（核兵器を搭載している可能性がある）の近くに何かが着陸した場合、それが「防衛上の考慮事項ではないというのは全くばかげている」と強く非難。

    • Gary Baker: "and for the MOD to say that UFOs are of no defence consideration is absolutely ludicrous, because if something lands next to an air base, whether it's RAF or USAF, and that base has nuclear weapons on board, excuse me, that's very, very serious, and it is of defence significance."

  • 結論としての国防省の欺瞞疑惑:ベイカーは、「国防省はおそらく、そしてほぼ確実に、真実を控えめに語っているか、最悪の場合、嘘をついて情報を隠蔽している」と確信している。 事件のレーダー写真や、自身の知らない他の情報も存在すると確信している。

    • Gary Baker: "And I have no doubt that there is radar pictures of the event, and possibly others outside of my knowledge as well."

結論​

ゲイリー・ベイカーの証言は、レンドルシャムのUFO事件に関する国防省の公式見解に重大な疑問を投げかけるものです。冷戦時代という非常に機密性の高い時期に、重要な防空レーダーが「オフになっていた」という主張は、RAFニーティスヘッドの運営実態と、国防上の必要性から見て「ありえない」という強力な反論が示されています。

すべてのレーダー映像が記録されるという規則にもかかわらず、関連するレーダー記録が利用できないという事実は、国防省による情報隠蔽の可能性を強く示唆しています。この証言は、レンドルシャム事件の真実解明に向けた重要な手がかりとなるでしょう。

証言者：元RAF航空兵ゲイリー・ベイカー​

AI

レンドルシャムのUFO事件のより大きな文脈において、元RAF航空兵ゲイリー・ベイカー（1980年12月にRAFニーティスヘッド勤務）に関するソースの内容は以下の通りです。

ゲイリー・ベイカー（SPEAKER_00）は、‌‌1980年12月にRAFニーティスヘッドに勤務していた元RAF航空機整備兵（シニア・エアークラフトマン）‌‌であり、国防省（MOD）の公式見解に異議を唱える‌‌「新しい予期せぬ情報源」‌‌として紹介されています。

彼の証言とRAFニーティスヘッドでの経験は、レンドルシャム事件のレーダー映像に関する国防省の主張に疑問を投げかけています。

I was an airman, a senior air craftsman, in wire watch, and periodically, through my service at NETA's head, I would be allocated to watch duties. That would mean that I would do four days on and four days off. (00:04:46)

[Gary Baker]: On the four days on, you'd do two 12-hour day shifts, then two 12-hour night shifts. And the other squadron's watch would be manning the radar systems, the radar station and the ops room, when you're off duty. And so there would be lots of people, when the squadron were on duty, either earlies or lates, and a few people to maintain a basic skeleton crew when it was quiet, when there was no military air defence flying. And that crew was responsible for maintaining the integrity of the air defence of the southern half of the UK, recognising all the aircraft airborne, and providing a crew should we suddenly find ourselves in a position where we're at war, or an unknown aircraft turns up, or, as happened, Russian spy planes came over, and you were there to give the basic service requirement to carry out the air defence and control aspect of taking a fighter aircraft from its base to its interception with an unknown aircraft, and whatever the outcome of that may have been. (00:06:07)

[Gary Baker]: As part of the job of maintaining the integrity, the safety of the United Kingdom air defence environment, it's absolutely essential that radar coverage is maintained, because otherwise there's going to be holes in the radar coverage, and at a sensitive time between east and west, it's absolutely imperative that you maintain that safety. So the radar that RAF Nita said was in fact two radars, both of which were main air defence primary radars, and they were working night and day together, and at any one time you could change from one radar to the other on the radar tube on your screen in front of you, of which there were many in the Ops Room, many screens, all involved with doing different specific jobs to maintain this air defence safety. (00:07:17)

[Gary Baker]: And I actually know for a fact that these radars... Have they got a name? Yes, there's the Type 84 and the Type 85 radar, and also at Nita's head there was height finding radars, whose job was specifically involved in checking the height of aircraft, and they were called HF200, height finding radars. So these two radars are working together. If there was routine planned maintenance to them, or if one went wrong, which as all equipment does from time to time, and military equipment being no different from any other things, they do go wrong. But you don't have two things going wrong at the same time. (00:08:11)

[Gary Baker]: The planned maintenance would be planned so that one radar was operational while the other was, for a brief period of time, maintained to its full operating capacity, then switched back on again. But all these radars form the defence network, and all the aircraft which these radars pick up are recorded. All the radars are filmed, and that would be, for the obvious reasons, if there was an incident or a problem, the factors involved in that problem could be traced and tracked and looked at and analysed. So it's imperative that the radar picture is recorded, and that's not just for incidents or emergencies or problems, it's also for purposes such as training, because if you're going to let lots of people loose on real situations, it's best that they train from what's gone before, and radar tapes are no different. (00:09:29)

[Gary Baker]: But all radar is recorded. NETAS Head sent its radar picture to other establishments, and one of which was RAF Watton Eastern Radar, which was an air traffic establishment, which is distinct from air defence radar. Air traffic, in my understanding, were involved in the transit of an aircraft from one place to another, and also the taking off and landing of those aircraft. Aircraft involved in defence of the realm, interceptions, and ancillary aircraft integral to maintaining that capability, such as airborne early warning aircraft, or tankers, to refuel aircraft in flight, also fall under the air defence umbrella. So the two are separate, but interlinked. (00:10:27)

[Gary Baker]: With regard to the Rendlesham incident, obviously I'd been aware of that for a number of years through reading about it, and I've had an interest in that during that time, but felt that I personally didn't have anything to add to the incident of a UFO landing at RAF Bentwater's Stroke Woodbridge. But I had information, or a knowledge, of some happenings from my Air Force times. Whether they were linked was hard for me to say, or if I felt I had something to say, it was of such a low level of importance to my opinion at the time, that I felt, oh well, that's interesting, and just followed the story the same as anybody else. (00:11:19)

[Gary Baker]: But it wasn't until the end of August, when reading UFO magazine, and the article written by Georgina Bruni, stating that the MOD had released information regarding the Rendlesham Forest UFO incident, mentioning RAF Neetershead and RAF Watton, and the radar station, and the fact that the radar camera was switched off at RAF Neetershead, and coincidentally the radar tapes from RAF Easton at Watton had been processed with a very poor, ineligible result, I find absolutely unacceptable. Bearing in mind, this happened at a time when the backdrop was the Cold War, air defence of our country, and of NATO, was very, very important. (00:12:18)

[Gary Baker]: The UFO flap, and the MOD, had come down to take away the radar tapes. (00:12:25)

[SPEAKER_01]: Now, let's just qualify this again. Although you can't be certain of the actual date, you know it's Christmas. (00:12:32)

[Gary Baker]: Yes, this is 21 years ago. It wasn't a major deal. I'm perhaps no different from anybody else in society. To remember exactly dates and times, 20 odd years ago, is a very difficult thing to do. Bearing in mind that that particular date or dates of the so-called occurrences at Bentwaters and Woodbridge, for me, would not have meant anything to me at the time. It is inconceivable that the RAF would not have had their radar cameras working on at least one of the radars, perhaps not of NETASED, but of another establishment. There would definitely be film of radar of that incident of that time. (00:13:24)

[SPEAKER_01]: Tell us, what was the discussion? Who was talking about this? Was it the NCOs, were the officers, or was it just ordinary aircrew? Were they talking about any specifics? How, for instance, did this rumour start or this claim emerge about taking the radar tapes? I'm not sure how it came about. Was it talk as you went into the Ops Room, or was it talk over the canteen table? (00:13:54)

[Gary Baker]: It would have been a combination of all those, bearing in mind that there would have been a Christmas break at NETASED at that time for the main squadron duties, but a watch system would have operated. But for the bulk of the personnel on the squadrons, they would have come back to NETASED after the Christmas break period, and full of the same talk as anybody else in any walk of life, did you have a nice Christmas, all the rest of it. But, within that, there was rumours spoken about. (00:14:33)

[Gary Baker]: It would be, my nickname in the Air Force was Swiller, Swiller Baker, for some reason. It would be, hello Swill, have you heard there's been a big UFO flap on, and the MOD's been down and taken away the radar pictures, and that could have happened in the crew room during a tea break, or a quiet period in the Ops Room, or on the bus on the way to work. (00:14:55)

[SPEAKER_01]: But from where you're sat now, although we're talking about events almost 21 years ago, you can sit there now and look at that camera and tell people that that is exactly what was said at that time? (00:15:09)

[Gary Baker]: Yes, and it wasn't just one or two people, there was lots of people talking about it. I've recently been in contact with an old colleague of mine who served on 2 Squadron with me during that period, and I haven't spoken to him for 15 years. I contacted him through his mum's address, who I happened to have visited 20 years ago, and she still lived at the same part of London, and I got the telephone number of my friend, Mr X. I'm not going to give his name, because he hasn't given me permission to at this time, but he remembers exactly the same rumours. (00:15:48)

[Gary Baker]: And when I discussed it with him, I didn't make any connections with the Rendlesham Forest thing at the time, I just asked him if he'd had any recollection of a UFO flap and the MOD coming, etc, and he did have that recollection in the same degree of accuracy as myself. Not pinned down or honed to a specific time, date, person, etc, but a memory from a period, and that would be from that period. Seeing UFOs for the average person in the street isn't an everyday occurrence, at least it isn't for me, and same with radar pictures, they don't appear all over the place, and when they do, it gets talked about. (00:16:39)

[Gary Baker]: I believe I've maintained and upheld the spirit of the Official Secrets Act. I've decided to say what I'm saying now on the strength of the MOD releasing information. If they chose to release what I consider to be the wrong information, I feel it's incumbent on me to offer an alternative view from the standpoint of an ordinary serving member of an establishment that would be involved in air defence aspects, and for the MOD to say that UFOs are of no defence consideration is absolutely ludicrous, because if something lands next to an air base, whether it's RAF or USAF, and that base has nuclear weapons on board, excuse me, that's very, very serious, and it is of defence significance. (00:17:33)

[Gary Baker]: And I want to say, however small my part in this was, that the MOD probably, and almost certainly, are being economical with the truth, or at worst, lying through their teeth and are withholding information on this. And I have no doubt that there is radar pictures of the event, and possibly others outside of my knowledge as well. (00:18:01)

(2025-08-29)

entry.title: Missing-411 : Jared Negrete の事例 ⇒ この謎を推測する
entry.content:
前置き​

1991年に起きた Missing-411 の事例を取り上げる。

末尾で、この謎を推測する。

概要​

AI

ジャレッド・ネグレテの不可解な失踪

この動画の文字起こしは、‌‌ジャレッド・ネグレテの不可解な失踪‌‌について語っています。

1991年、ジャレッドはボーイスカウトの活動でサンバーナーディーノ山脈をハイキング中に姿を消しました。このソースは、‌‌彼の失踪に至る経緯、広範な捜索活動、そして発見された手がかり‌‌について詳述しています。

また、ジャレッドの失踪と同様の他の行方不明事件にも触れ、‌‌事故、動物の襲撃、誘拐、さらには超常現象‌‌といった様々な仮説を提示し、どれも決定的な説明にはなっていないことを強調しています。

目次​

  1. 前置き
  2. 概要
  3. 詳細
    1. 1. 主要テーマの概要
    2. 2. 事案の背景と重要な事実
    3. 3. 大規模な捜索活動と発見物
    4. 4. 類似のケースとウィリアム・パービンの話
    5. 5. 失踪に関する主な理論
    6. 6. 結論と残された謎
  4. ウィリアム・パービンの類似の失踪と帰還
  5. 異次元・別の現実への移動（ポータル）説
  6. 時系列
  7. 主要関係者
  8. この事件の謎を推測する
  9. 情報源
  10. 文字起こし

詳細​

AI

ブリーフィング資料：ジャレッド・ネグレテの不可解な失踪

1. 主要テーマの概要​

この資料は、1991年にサンバーナーディーノ山脈のサンゴルゴニオ山で発生した12歳のボーイスカウト、ジャレッド・ネグレテの不可解な失踪に関する複数の情報源をレビューし、主要なテーマと重要な事実、および提示された理論をまとめています。この事件は、多数の捜索活動にもかかわらず、彼の遺体が一切発見されなかったため、「奇妙な失踪」として世界中で注目を集めました。

2. 事案の背景と重要な事実​

  • 失踪者: ジャレッド・マイケル・ネグレテ、1978年9月11日生まれ、失踪時12歳。アルモンテ、カリフォルニア州出身の普通の少年。世界に対する深い好奇心を持ち、ボーイスカウトに入団。
  • 所属: ビッグベアーマウンテンに拠点を置く「キャンプ・ターキッツ」というボーイスカウト隊に所属。モルモン教会と提携。
  • 失踪日: 1991年7月19日、サンバーナーディーノ山脈のサンゴルゴニオ山（標高11,500フィート）でのオーバーナイト遠征中。
  • 装備: 小型カメラ、軽食、スカウトの制服、満タンの水筒。しかし、適切な登山靴ではなく、ハイカットのスニーカーを着用。
  • 身体的特徴: 身長5フィート2インチ、体重150ポンド（当時の基準ではやや肥満）。活動的な子供であったが、普段のキャンプ地（標高約6,500フィート）よりもはるかに高い標高に曝されることになった。眼鏡を処方されていたが、失踪当日は着用していなかったか、持参していなかった。
  • 同行者: 他の少年スカウト4名と、引率リーダーのデニス・ナイト1名。
  • 登山ルート: ビビアンクリークトレイル。往復17マイルで、地形のため一般的に難しいとされている。
  • 失踪の状況:ハイキング2日目、頂上に向かう途中、ジャレッドは経験豊富な他のメンバーについていけなくなり、午後6時頃にはかなり遅れをとった。
  • 引率リーダーのデニス・ナイトは、「少年がペースについていくのに苦労しているのを見て、休憩所で彼を置き去りにするという意識的な選択をした」という報告と、「他のハイカーから一人のスカウトが遅れていると知らされ、頂上まで進み、帰路でジャレッドを回収するつもりだった」という報告の2つがある。いずれにせよ、ジャレッドはすぐに一人になった。
  • 複数のハイカーが、ジャレッドが一人で、しかもトレイルを外れて歩いているのを目撃している（標高約10,000フィート）。サンタアナの消防士を含むハイカーグループは、彼に「ショートカットは非常に危険なので、マークされた道にとどまるよう」忠告した。
  • その後もジャレッドを見たというハイカーがいたが、彼は忠告に従わず、「曲がりくねったスイッチバックの間の道を走っていた」と証言されている。
  • その時点で目撃情報が途絶えた。隊が下山する際、ジャレッドは見つからなかった。
  • 引率リーダーは、日が暮れる前に短い捜索を行った後、残りの隊員を12マイル先の安全な場所まで連れて行き、それから助けを呼んだ。

3. 大規模な捜索活動と発見物​

  • 捜索開始: 1991年7月20日午前7時に開始。
  • 参加者: 捜索救助隊、ヘリコプター（暗視・赤外線技術搭載）、捜索犬、馬、数十人のボランティア。
  • 捜索範囲: 130平方マイルに及ぶ険しい地形。
  • 地形の困難さ: 「サンゴルゴニオ山は基本的にギザギザの岩、急な崖、特に渓谷や小川の周辺の密な植生の海」と表現される。
  • 最初の夜の状況: 気温は非常に穏やかで、低体温症の可能性は低いとされた。持っていた食料で数日間は生き延びられたはず。
  • 突破口（2日目）: ビビアンクリークトレイルの約10,000フィート地点で、ジャレッドのスニーカーに一致する一足の足跡を発見。足跡はトレイルから大きく外れた、非常に危険な岩肌の斜面にあった。他の足跡は見つからなかった。
  • 決定的な手がかり（7月27日）: 焦点地域を6平方マイルに絞り込んだ捜索で、斜面の下部からジャレッドのバックパックを発見。
  • 中にはキャンディの包み紙、ジャーキー、そしてカメラが入っていた。
  • カメラには12枚の未現像写真。最初の11枚は風景写真だったが、最後の1枚は「ジャレッドの顔の劇的なクローズアップショットで、目と鼻だけが写っている」不気味なものだった。フラッシュを使って夜間に撮影されたことが明らか。
  • 捜索の終了: 16日間の捜索の後、8月4日に公式に打ち切られた。郡保安官は生存の可能性はほぼないと述べ、ジャレッドは低体温症または遭難による死亡と推定された。
  • 捜索の特異性: 遺体、私物、衣服のいずれも発見されなかった。動物による襲撃の兆候（引きずり痕、刺し傷、血痕など）もなかったため、動物によるものも排除された。「まるで彼がパックを置いて立ち去り、そのまま忽然と姿を消したかのようだった」。

4. 類似のケースとウィリアム・パービンの話​

  • 一般的な失踪: 「毎年、数十万人もの人々がアメリカ中で行方不明になる。ほとんどは最終的に発見されるが、安全な場合もあればそうでない場合もある。しかし、何らかの理由で完全に痕跡なく姿を消す特異な人々もいる」。
  • 経験豊富なハイカーの失踪: 1988年のティモシー・バーンズ（ヨセミテ国立公園）や2015年のモーガン・ハイマー（コロラド川ラフティングガイド）の例が挙げられ、経験豊富な者でも痕跡なく失踪するケースは多い。
  • ウィリアム・パービンの生還: ジャレッドの失踪から10年後の2001年8月、サンゴルゴニオ山で17歳のハイカー、ウィリアム・パービンが行方不明になった。ジャレッドの両親も捜索に協力するほどの類似点があったが、ウィリアムは数日後、ホワイトウォーターの町で再出現した。彼は道に迷い、30マイル以上も逆方向に進み、水や食料もなく、川の水を飲んで病気になり、崖から落ちて脳震盪を起こし、数日間幻覚を見ていたと主張した。この生還はジャレッドの事件の悲劇と謎を消すものではなかった。

5. 失踪に関する主な理論​

5.1 過失と登山技術の欠如​

  • 引率リーダーの責任: 「ジャレッド・ネグレテがその日行方不明になったのは、多くのことが間違っていたためであり、その責任の多くは引率リーダーであるデニス・ナイトにある」。
    • ボーイスカウトの規則では、たとえスカウトの人数が少なくても、ハイキンググループに一人のスカウトマスターしかいないことはあってはならない。理想的には、大人が一人は列の前に、もう一人は後ろに歩くべき。
    • スカウトに適切な履物を着用させていなかった。「困難と評価されるハイキングは、運動靴で行うべきではない」。
    • ジャレッド自身の要因:ベテランのハイカーではなかった。
    • シティボーイであり、ほとんどの野外経験はキャンプ・ターキッツ（標高6,500フィート）に集中していた。
    • サンゴルゴニオ山での標高（最高11,500フィート、最後に目撃されたのが約10,000フィート）は、彼が慣れている標高よりも大幅に高かった。
    • 体重が平均的な12歳よりもやや重く、BMIの観点からは過体重と見なされた。

5.2 環境的要因（最も有力視されるが、疑問点も残る）​

  • 滑落事故: 「最も単純な説明は、ジャレッドが落ちたということ」。

    • サンゴルゴニオ山周辺の地形は「急な崖、隠れた渓谷、ギザギザの崖面」があり、許容範囲が狭い。
    • 目撃情報通り、彼がトレイルからわずかに外れただけでも、足を踏み外して、捜索隊がアクセスできないほど危険な場所や密生した場所に転落した可能性。
    • 密生した植生が低い斜面を覆っており、小さな体が隠蔽された可能性。
    • 時間の経過とともに、自然のプロセスと腐肉食動物が痕跡を消し、衣服やその他の持ち物が散乱し失われた可能性。
    • 疑問点: 遺体が見つかっていないこと。150ポンドの遺体であれば、腐肉食動物の注意を引き、その活動が見過ごされることはないはず。また、バックパック、カメラ、食料が「放置されたままで手つかず」で見つかったことを説明できない（トレイルから約45フィート）。

  • 高山病: ジャレッドは標高8,000フィート以上で始まる高山病に苦しんでいた可能性。

    • ジャレッドが慣れていた標高よりも1,500フィート以上高く、最後に目撃された標高よりも2,000フィート低い場所から症状が出始める。
    • 高山病は頭痛、混乱、さらには幻覚を引き起こし、判断力を損なう可能性。
    • これにより、彼はパックや食料を非論理的な理由で捨てた可能性。
    • 疑問点: 遺体が見つからないことを説明できない。

  • 動物による襲撃: この地域にはヘビ、クマ、マウンテンライオンなどが生息しているのは事実。

    • 疑問点: 滑落事故の理論と同じ問題に直面。遺体、衣服、骨、特に靴など、「何か」は残るはず。

  • 水路への転落: 山にはサンタアナ川やホワイトウォーター川など、複数の水路や小さな小川がある。

    • 高山病で方向感覚を失い、パックなしで、水路を渡ろうとしたり、水を飲もうとして転落し、下流に流された可能性。
    • これにより、遺体が捜索範囲から何マイルも離れた場所に運ばれた可能性。
    • 水中での分解プロセスは異なり、骨は何十年も水中に残る可能性がある。
    • 疑問点: 捜索犬が水路に繋がる痕跡を一切見つけられなかったこと。

5.3 より不穏な、または超常的な理論​

  • 誘拐: 1980年代から90年代にかけて、カリフォルニアは「誘拐の首都」と呼ばれた。

    • 当日山には多くの人がおり、迷子で怯えている少年を捕食者が助けるふりをして連れ去った可能性は排除できない。
    • バックパックを「目くらまし」として山に残した可能性。
    • 利点: 遺体が見つからない理由を説明できる。
    • 疑問点: 専門家は、山の環境的危険性よりも可能性は低いと考えている。

  • 宇宙人による誘拐: 南カリフォルニアの山々はUFO目撃情報と長く関連付けられている。

    • ビッグベアー湖周辺はUFOホットスポット。
    • ハイカーやキャンパーが標的になることが多いとUFO研究家は主張。
    • 2006年には、サンゴルゴニオ山近くで三角形の大型の無音の飛行物体が目撃されている。
    • 利点: 捜索犬がパックから離れた痕跡を見つけられなかったことや、その後の痕跡がないことを説明できる。

  • 別次元への移行（ポータル理論）: 「ジャレッド・ネグレテは全く行方不明ではない。驚くべきことだが、彼はポータルを通して別の現実に移行したのかもしれない」。

    • 過去100年間、別の時代、次元、現実のバージョンに突然移行したという報告が多数ある。これらの事象は一時的なことが多いが、永久的な場合もあると主張する人もいる。
    • この現象は、多くの場合、荒野、特に巨礫地帯や山の近くで発生すると信じられている。
